text: Three customers hit 429s on the bulk shipments endpoint this morning. Nordwind got throttled mid-import and lost a 4000-row batch. Who owns the rate limiter?
Marcus is on the limiter rewrite. The current one is the old fixed-window thing that counts per API key, which is why a single bulk import eats the whole budget.
Any ETA I can give Nordwind? They're asking whether to reschedule their weekly import.
Can't commit to a date. The rewrite needs the Redis cluster upgrade first and that isn't scheduled. Details are on the issue.
I'll tell them to split imports under 1000 rows as a workaround. Third time I've given that advice this month.
For the record, the bulk import 429s are now the top support driver two months running. If the Redis upgrade is the blocker we should schedule the Redis upgrade.
